notes.title: Security Vulnerabilities Found: Update Nvidia Drivers Now with Driver Booster
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Recently, more than five security vulnerabilities have been found in the NVIDIA GeForce, NVS, Quadro and Tesla graphics processing unit (GPU) display drivers for Windows. These flaws could enable a denial of service attack as well as the escalation of privileges to enable an attacker to execute malware on your Windows computer.

But don’t worry. You can patch these flaws by simply updating your drivers. With Driver Booster 6 PRO, you can get latest drivers at real-time and keep your computer safe.
